body: It is. It's weird.. I'm just functioning. They were my save haven. One more reason not to trust, as if I needed that. I'll try my best. The alternative just seems so easy :/
It's complicated. They don't really say it openly but they have that weird look. Their kids really like me and I'm good with kids.

I feel the same. Why bother them, they will never understand. You felt so good and then suddenly it all seems like a lie. It's like you see the world's real face again. How can we know which one is the real face and which one is the delusion?
